title: H3174 (122nd General Assembly): Concealable weapons

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, South Carolina); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Carolina text (Introduced, 2016-12-15; official copy, https://www.scstatehouse.gov/sess122_2017-2018/prever/3174_20161215.htm (LegiScan doc 1439370))
provenance.note: Introduced text, Dec. 15, 2016. No votes. Struck 'and' in item (11); added '; and' in item (12).

operative_text:
Section 1 (Section 23-31-240): Notwithstanding any other provision contained in this article, the following persons who possess a valid permit pursuant to this article may carry a concealable weapon anywhere within this State, when carrying out the duties of their office:
Section 1 (Section 23-31-240): (13) victim advocates employed by a law enforcement agency.
